title: Group health insurance for employees + self
summary: Group plans often offer better coverage at lower per-employee cost than individual marketplace plans. Premiums deductible to the business.
detailsHtml:
Coverage decisions

Group plans require participation thresholds (typically 70%+ of eligible employees enrolled). HDHP-with-HSA options at the company level let employees access HSAs. Contribution levels (typically 50–75% employer-paid for employee, less for dependents) materially affect employee retention and hiring competitiveness.

QSEHRA and ICHRA for small businesses

If a group plan is too expensive, Qualified Small Employer Health Reimbursement Arrangements (QSEHRAs, for businesses with <50 employees) and Individual Coverage HRAs (ICHRAs) let you reimburse employees for individual marketplace premiums on a pre-tax basis. Often a better economic structure for small/early businesses than group plans.
